notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Erratic Portal.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control seven of more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.
